steps: EXCLUDE infective colitis (stool culture + C. difficile toxin) before/with immunosuppression.
Acute severe UC: admit, IV corticosteroids, VTE prophylaxis, monitor (Truelove-Witts / day-3 response).
Steroid-refractory severe UC: rescue ciclosporin or infliximab; early surgical review (colectomy).
Crohn's flare: corticosteroids to induce remission; optimise/escalate maintenance (immunomodulator/biologic).
Avoid antimotility agents in severe colitis (toxic megacolon risk); nutrition support.

confirm: Bloody diarrhoea, urgency, abdominal pain ± systemic features in known/new IBD; raised CRP/faecal calprotectin; exclude infection (incl. C. difficile).
